description_short: Shows live Train Network capacity by Waiting bay and wagon type, while retaining the grouped fleet traffic-jam alert.
description_long: Train Network Monitor Live capacity visibility plus one fleet-wide traffic-jam alert. Live Train Network dashboard Open the toolbar dashboard to see every non-empty Train Network. Each network shows occupied / total trains, busy / total Waiting bays, and occupied / total trains for each wagon type present: Unit, Loose, Fluid, Molten, Universal, Mixed, or an unlabeled generic train row when no cargo-wagon type applies. Empty networks and zero-count type rows stay hidden. The dashboard keeps no history and makes no capacity decisions. One jam, one alert When sustained congestion affects at least three trains and at least 10% of the active fleet, the mod raises one critical alert in the game's normal Alerts panel. Its (Nx) counter shows how many trains are affected, without flooding the panel with one notification per train. The alert clears automatically when traffic recovers. Find the blockage Click the alert to focus the longest-waiting train. Click again to cycle through the other affected trains. Choose how long to wait Set the delay from 1 to 12 in-game months; 12 months is one in-game year. The default is one month. Each uninterrupted wait is timed independently, and the timer resets when the train leaves a waiting-for-track state. Optional automatic pause Enable Pause on red alert to pause once when this mod's traffic-jam alert begins. Other game alerts are unaffected. The mod never resumes the game automatically, and manually resuming during the same jam will not immediately pause it again. What it changes The monitor reads current Train Network and waiting-for-track state only. It does not alter train routing, priorities, schedules, or behavior. The dashboard stores no data; alert settings are stored per save. The mod can be added to or removed from an existing game. Works with base-game trains and with trains added by the Trains expansion.
